description: This file defines the implementation of the Eos class, which manages the end-of-stream operation for a WebAudio player context within a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It includes constructor, destructor, and execute method implementations, and interacts with external GStreamer wrapper functions.

classes.name: Eos
classes.description: Class responsible for signaling end-of-stream in a WebAudio player context, utilizing GStreamer wrapper functions.

methods.name: Eos::Eos
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Eos object with a WebAudioPlayerContext and a GStreamer wrapper.

methods.name: Eos::~Eos
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of Eos object lifecycle.

methods.name: Eos::execute
methods.description: Method that triggers the end-of-stream signal via the GStreamer wrapper and logs the operation.
